Built for this platform

What you can do with X Ads MCP

01

Understand campaign traffic

Report on spend, impressions, link clicks, CTR, CPC, and CPM. X engagement clicks are not treated as website link clicks, and unsupported conversion metrics remain absent.

02

Inspect line items and funding

List campaign line items and existing funding instruments. This reads the billing context needed for campaign planning without creating or changing payment instruments.

03

Handle longer reporting periods

Short ranges use synchronous analytics; longer periods use asynchronous jobs in bounded chunks. Date handling follows account timezones and rejects unsupported boundaries.

Know what the data means

Conversions, conversion value, CPA, and ROAS are not normalized by this provider yet. API-contract tests do not prove live approval, pricing, or advertiser eligibility. Previewed campaign writes remain subject to X accepting the request.

Local setup · Bring your own credentials

Connect X Ads to Claude Code or Cursor.

The npm CLI and MCP server run on your machine. You need Node.js 22.13 or newer, your own provider credentials, and permission to access the ad account.

01 Install Adport

npm install -g adport

02 Connect X Ads

adport connect x

The wizard verifies account discovery using OAuth 1.0a credentials and saves the local grant. A bearer token is not a replacement for the four-part Ads API credential set.

03 Check your connection

adport doctor
adport accounts --provider x

Check that the intended account appears before asking your agent to report on it. Never paste tokens, client secrets, or private keys into chat.

Before you connect

  • An X developer app specifically approved for the Ads API. General X API access is not equivalent to Ads API approval.
  • The app consumer key and consumer secret plus a user access token and access-token secret.
  • Supply X_CONSUMER_KEY, X_CONSUMER_SECRET, X_ACCESS_TOKEN, and X_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET securely in your environment.
Full X Ads connection guideOfficial X Ads API documentation

Adport is independent and is not endorsed by X Ads. Provider access and approval are separate from installing this package.

Use X Ads from your agent.

X Ads in Claude Code

After connecting locally, register Adport as a stdio MCP server:

claude mcp add --transport stdio adport -- adport mcp

Start a new session and ask Claude to list your connected X Ads accounts.

Claude Code MCP documentation

X Ads in Cursor

Add this entry to your Cursor MCP configuration. Merge it with existing servers rather than replacing them:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "adport": {
      "command": "adport",
      "args": [
        "mcp"
      ]
    }
  }
}

The command must be available on Cursor’s PATH. Enable the server and ask the agent to inspect your account.

You stay in control

A suggestion is not a live change.

The first mutation call returns a preview and a short-lived pending-operation token. Applying requires that token and the same arguments. Budget caps and protected accounts are checked by the policy engine; new campaigns are paused by policy.

Local operations are recorded in an append-only audit log. An approved preview is not a guarantee of provider acceptance, and a connected agent does not grant additional account permissions.

X Ads MCP questions

Does Twitter Ads require different MCP setup from X Ads?

No. They refer to the same advertising provider here. Use adport connect x with an Ads API-approved app and OAuth 1.0a user credentials, not general-purpose X bearer-token authentication.

Can I use X Ads locally without Adport Cloud?

Yes. Install Adport from npm, connect your own X Ads credentials, and register the local MCP server with a stdio-compatible agent such as Claude Code or Cursor. Your provider may have its own approval, access, or billing requirements.

Why can I connect an account but not read a report or apply a change?

Account discovery, reporting, and mutations can require different permissions. Check the requested account, provider app scopes, advertiser eligibility, and environment. Start with adport doctor and the connection guide above. Do not bypass a denied operation by sharing secrets with the agent.
